verdict.rationale: Sardine documents initial and ongoing daily OFAC sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening of customers, with tunable fuzzy-match thresholds. It also offers UBO screening that combines KYB with KYC/AML and applies OFAC's 50 Percent Rule for ownership, so both individuals and companies are covered. However, the docs never show a compliance officer choosing which sanctions lists or watchlists to screen against, and list coverage beyond OFAC is not described. Missing for 10: documented selection or configuration of specific lists, explicit company or entity sanctions screening flow, list coverage beyond OFAC, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen individuals and companies against selected sanctions and watchlists

citations.quote: Sardine enables you to perform both an initial screening and an ongoing daily OFAC Sanctions, PEP, and Adverse Media screening, ensuring screening on both existing and new customers.
you can also enroll users for ongoing monitoring, which means that we'll alert you if any of your customers end up on one of these lists.
We allow you to tweak the thresholds for fuzzy matches such that you can balance the trade-off between true positives and false positive alerts.
UBO Screening `live`: Leverage a unique capability of Sardine, combining business verification (KYB) with customer verification (KYC/AML).
Apply ownership and control rules, including OFAC's 50 Percent Rule.
